It correctly rejects the spring premise, uses fixed k and m^(-1/2), and identifies mass cancellation in the pendulum. Post-blind reconciliation: Fixed-k omega^2=k/m and pendulum mg/l versus inertia m cancellation support every clause of true c.

Post-blind reconciliation: Dropping m from pendulum restoring coefficient mg/l yields the spurious m^(-1/2) relation in false d. This deliberately wrong derivation is not an endorsed equation.
